title: Incremental drafts and handoff
summary: Project drafts can register one asset at a time. Final handoff requires both logo and wordmark exports.
acceptance_criteria: A first PNG can pass the normal inventory check after artwork readiness is satisfied.
The explicit handoff check requires both required roles.

evidence.claim: Source at the recorded revision implements the described capability.
The adopter run registered drafts incrementally and exercised rejection of an incomplete handoff.
